Package io.github.jabrena.juno.api.lego

package io.github.jabrena.juno.api.lego
LEGO Powered Up hubs over Bluetooth LE: PoweredUpHubRemote, backed by the Arduino ArduinoBLE library, and the LEGO Mindstorms RCX infrared remote protocol: RcxRemote and, for its sensors, RcxBrick, and Scout brick commands in ScoutRemote, plus the Power Functions IR receiver in PowerFunctionsRemote; the three infrared classes are built on Infrared.

Works on the UNO R4 WiFi (its ESP32-S3 module provides the BLE radio) and the UNO Q (whose Linux side lends its Bluetooth adapter over Arduino_RouterBridge), with the ArduinoBLE library installed (arduino-cli lib install ArduinoBLE; 2.1.0 or newer on the UNO Q).

    Package
    Description
    io.github.jabrena.juno.api
    The Java-facing hardware API that Juno's compiler recognizes as intrinsics.
  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    PoweredUpHubRemote
    A LEGO Powered Up hub (City Hub 88009, Technic Hub 88012, BOOST Move Hub 88006, DUPLO Train Hub, ...) controlled over Bluetooth Low Energy, recognized as compiler intrinsics by Juno and backed by the Arduino ArduinoBLE library (arduino-cli lib install ArduinoBLE).
    PowerFunctionsRemote
    A LEGO Power Functions infrared remote (8885), which drives the motors, lights and servos plugged into an IR Receiver (8884) set to one of its four channels.
    RcxBrick
    Direct commands to an RCX brick that answer back, over the same infrared link as RcxRemote (set it up with RcxRemote.begin(int, int) first, with both the IR LED and the IR receiver module wired).
    RcxRemote
    The LEGO Mindstorms RCX infrared protocol, recognized as compiler intrinsics by Juno: receives the button state of an RCX Remote Control (9709) and transmits the same remote-control and message commands to an RCX brick.
    ScoutRemote
    Remote control of a LEGO Scout brick (Robotics Discovery Set) over infrared, plain Java on top of Infrared: see there for the wiring of the IR receiver module and the IR LED.
